Policy: AscNet policy, not retail protocol data: search vocabulary for the /warzone set and /warzone zones commands. Zones themselves (ids, names, BuffIds, Desc, MarkId, stages) always come from Resources/table/share/fuben/arena/AreaStage.tsv; this file only names the element of each zone buff id and the encounter type of each AreaStage.Desc prefix, and lists per element the ArenaAreaBuffDetails weather icons (IconAffix*Up) whose weather groups the server prefers for that zone (AscNet policy: retail per-activity weather assignment is unavailable). EncounterTypes order is the default preference when /warzone set is given no type.
Source: Curated from the community dataset agus/data/wz_element_map.json (by_buff_id, type_by_prefix) and pgr_warzone_zones.json, cross-checked against AreaStage.tsv BuffIds/BuffName/Desc. Element keywords are local command aliases.
